name: Episode Prewarm
description: Preloads the beginning of the next episode when playback reaches a configurable progress threshold.
overview: Asynchronously reads 1 MiB from the next episode with a persistent 6-hour cooldown per episode.

versions.changelog: Add the session-start trigger using the user's most recent episode or movie. Resume episodes below the configured threshold, advance to the next episode at or above it, and skip completed movies. Centralize plugin, assembly, file, and release versioning in Directory.Build.props.

Add item-detail request triggers and resolve series, season, and collection containers to concrete playable media. Use per-user playback history and the configured progress threshold to select the appropriate episode, while retaining a shared queue and global per-item cooldown.
Fix settings page save flow: prevent page reload and show save/load errors and confirmation.
Fix XML serialization of persisted per-episode cooldown state; store cooldown entries in an XML-serializable list.
Initial release: asynchronous next-episode preloading, per-episode 6-hour cooldown, configurable playback threshold, and runtime statistics.
